The interior amenities focus on practical functionality with driver and passenger vanity mirrors, a rear seat center armrest, and convenient door bins for storage. This 2013 Chevrolet Silverado 3500HD LT represents a capable work truck built to handle demanding tasks with proven reliability and practical functionality.

- Duramax 6.6L V8 Turbodiesel engine with 397 hp and 765 lb-ft of torque
- Allison 1000 6-Speed Automatic transmission with electronic grade braking and tow/haul mode
- 4WD with electronic shift transfer case for enhanced traction control
- Locking tailgate with EZ-Lift design for convenient cargo access
- Driver 6-way power seat adjuster with manual lumbar control
- Engine block heater for reliable cold-weather starts
- Convenience Package with adjustable power pedals, rear parking assist, and remote vehicle starter
- 17" forged polished aluminum wheels with spare tire
- Rear vision camera with inside auto-dimming mirror display
- Integrated trailer brake controller for safe towing operations
- Heavy-duty handling and trailering suspension package
- Heated power-adjustable mirrors with turn signal indicators
- SiriusXM satellite radio with 6-speaker audio system
- Chrome bumpers and body-colored bodyside molding
- 730 CCA heavy-duty dual battery for demanding applications

The truck's substantial diesel engine delivers the torque needed for heavy-duty applications, while the Allison automatic transmission provides smooth power delivery and advanced towing capabilities.

The interior offers comfort features that balance work-ready durability with driver amenities. The power seat with lumbar adjustment, leather-wrapped steering wheel, and climate controls create a functional cabin environment. Practical touches like the overhead console, compass, and outside temperature display support everyday usability.

Safety and visibility receive appropriate attention with four-wheel disc brakes, dual front airbags, and a security system. The rear vision camera paired with the auto-dimming mirror display enhances backing and parking confidence. The trailering wiring provisions accommodate various towing setups for those who need versatile hauling options.

This Silverado 3500HD LT comes equipped to serve as a dependable work companion. Whether you need heavy-duty capability for professional use or a substantial truck for personal projects, this diesel-powered pickup delivers the performance and features buyers expect from this class of vehicle.

We invite you to visit our showroom to inspect this Silverado 3500HD in detail and discuss how it meets your transportation needs.

description: If you're searching for a capable, powerful, and fully loaded full-size truck, this 2018 RAM 1500 Crew Cab Sport for sale at Turbo Motors in Taylor, Michigan deserves a serious look. With its iconic HEMI V8 engine, 4WD capability, and aggressive Sport trim styling, this is the kind of truck that gets things done — whether you're hauling across Wayne County or heading out on the weekend for something a little more adventurous.About This 2018 RAM 1500 Crew Cab Sport This 2018 RAM 1500 Crew Cab Sport (Stock #3256TM, VIN: 1C6RR7UT1JS205835) is a high-mileage workhorse that represents exceptional value for buyers who want serious truck capability without the premium price tag of a low-mileage unit. At 190,557 miles, this RAM has clearly been put to work — and that's actually a testament to how well-built this generation of Ram 1500 truly is. The 2018 model year falls squarely in one of the most refined generations of Ram's half-ton lineup, and buyers across Wayne County and Southeast Michigan continue to seek them out for good reason. The Crew Cab body style adds full rear-door access and genuine rear-seat comfort, making this just as practical for families as it is for jobsite crews. The 6 1/3-foot bed gives you real cargo flexibility without the footprint of a full 8-foot box.2018 RAM 1500 Performance and Engine Under the hood sits Ram's legendary 5.7-liter HEMI V8 — one of the most recognizable engines in the truck world, and for good reason. This engine produces around 395 horsepower and 410 lb-ft of torque, giving the 2018 RAM 1500 the muscle to tow up to 10,680 lbs when properly equipped. Paired with Ram's smooth 8-speed automatic transmission, power delivery is refined and responsive whether you're merging onto I-75 in Taylor or pulling a trailer up a grade on the outskirts of Wayne County. The 8-speed gearbox also helps with fuel efficiency, allowing the HEMI to operate efficiently across a wide range of driving conditions. The 4WD drivetrain means this truck is ready for Michigan winters — from slick suburban streets to unpaved roads out in the county. This isn't a truck that asks permission from the weather.RAM 1500 Sport Features and Interior The Sport trim is Ram's performance-focused appearance package, and it delivers a distinctly aggressive look with body-color exterior accents, sport-tuned suspension, and bold badging throughout. Inside, Sport models typically feature upgraded seating materials, a sport steering wheel, and enhanced technology integration. The Crew Cab layout gives you a full rear seat that can comfortably fit three adults — a major advantage over extended or regular cab configurations. Expect features common to the 2018 Ram 1500 Sport to include an 8.4-inch Uconnect infotainment touchscreen, Bluetooth connectivity, backup camera, and a premium audio system. The cabin on the fifth-generation Ram 1500 earned widespread praise for its class-leading interior quality — it genuinely felt more like an SUV than a work truck inside.RAM 1500 Reliability and Ownership The 2013-2018 generation Ram 1500 has a well-earned reputation for durability and longevity. The 5.7-liter HEMI, in particular, is widely considered one of the most robust V8 engines in the half-ton segment. With proper maintenance — regular oil changes, cooling system care, and transmission fluid intervals — these engines routinely run well past 200,000 miles. At 190,417 miles, this truck is approaching that milestone, which means a pre-purchase inspection is always a smart move, but it also means the major mechanical components have already proven themselves. Ram's coil-spring rear suspension, which set the 1500 apart from its competitors in this era, contributes to a noticeably smoother ride than comparable F-150 or Silverado models. Owners consistently praise the HEMI's power delivery and the overall sense of solidity in this generation of Ram.Why Buy From Turbo Motors in Taylor, Michigan Turbo Motors, located right here in Taylor in Wayne County, Michigan, is a trusted name in the Southeast Michigan used vehicle market. Buying locally means you get to inspect the truck in person before you commit, work directly with people who know the market, and avoid the uncertainty of out-of-state purchases. Taylor sits at the heart of a region where trucks are more than a trend — they're a way of life. The team at Turbo Motors understands what Michigan truck buyers need and works to make the buying process straightforward and transparent. Whether you're a first-time truck buyer or upgrading from a previous Ram, the staff here is ready to help you make a confident decision.

description:
This 2021 Bentley Continental GT V8 represents a pinnacle of luxury automotive engineering, offering a sophisticated ownership experience that demands attention from discerning drivers.

- 4.0L V8 engine with 8-speed dual clutch transmission and AWD
- Mulliner Driving Specification with diamond quilted seats and embroidered emblems
- 12-way electric heated front bucket seats with premium Nappa leather
- Bentley Audio System with 10 speakers and DVD-Audio capability
- Navigation system with backup camera and parking assistance
- Heated front and rear seats with memory settings
- Inductive phone charger integrated throughout the cabin
- Bentley rotating display with authentic wood veneers
- LED welcome lamps by Mulliner with three-spoke heated steering wheel
- Electronic stability control with four-wheel independent suspension
- Speed-sensing steering and auto-leveling suspension for responsive handling
- Full suite of safety features including multiple airbags and emergency communication system
- Apple CarPlay connectivity for seamless device integration

The exterior presents itself in elegant gray, finished with body-color bumpers and chrome pinstripe accents along the fascia and door waistrails. The 21-inch alloy wheels provide a commanding stance while rain-sensing wipers and fully automatic headlights with fog lamps ensure confident operation in all conditions.

Interior appointments reflect Bentley's commitment to craftsmanship. The cabin features semi-aniline leather seat trim with contrast stitching, genuine wood console, dashboard, and door panel inserts, and embroidered Bentley emblems throughout. The cockpit design places all controls within easy reach, combining functionality with luxury.

Climate control maintains individual front zones with automatic temperature regulation, while heated front and rear seats with memory positioning ensure personalized comfort for every occupant. The steering wheel offers power adjustment with tilt and telescoping functions, and remote keyless entry integrates with the security system for peace of mind.

This 2023 Dodge Challenger SRT Hellcat Redeye Widebody Demon 170 represents the pinnacle of American muscle car engineering, delivered in striking Black with just 31 miles on the odometer. This vehicle combines raw performance capability with sophisticated technology and premium comfort features designed for drivers who demand the best.

Climate management is handled through automatic dual zone air conditioning with rear window defroster, ensuring comfort year-round. The Uconnect infotainment system offers seamless device connectivity through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, while media hub ports and satellite radio keep you entertained throughout your drive.

Performance and safety work in concert throughout this machine. The adaptive suspension system maintains stability and control, supported by four-wheel independent suspension and speed-sensing steering technology. The four-wheel disc brake system with anti-lock capability and electronic stability control provides confident stopping power. Emergency communication through SiriusXM Guardian and a comprehensive airbag system including dual front impact, front side impact, and overhead airbags reinforce your protection on every journey.

This Challenger delivers distinctive styling that commands attention. The widebody design features rear body flares and is complemented by body-color bumpers and exterior mirrors with heating elements. High-intensity discharge headlamps with DC illumination provide superior visibility, while the SRT Performance Spoiler and distinctive SRT Demon 170 badging announce this vehicle's true character. The Satin Black Dodge tail lamp badge and 1-Year NMCA/NHRA membership reflect the heritage built into every detail.

The fuel efficiency figures reflect realistic performance expectations: 13 mpg in city driving and 22 mpg on the highway for this supercharged powerhouse. As a flex fuel vehicle, this Challenger adapts to your fuel preferences while maintaining consistent performance capability.

This 2023 model arrives virtually untouched, with just 31 miles indicating it has been carefully preserved for the next owner. The combination of Demon 170 performance engineering, Redeye Widebody styling, and comprehensive technology integration creates an ownership experience that rewards every drive.

The four-wheel disc brakes with ABS provide confident stopping power.

With just 695 miles on the odometer, this DB11 Base remains essentially new and ready for an owner seeking a sophisticated British Grand Tourer. The combination of a potent V8 engine, refined interior appointments, and proven Aston Martin engineering creates a vehicle that bridges practical daily driving with genuine performance capability. We invite you to experience this distinctive motorcar and discover why the DB11 remains a benchmark in its class.

Configured with $14,400.00 in factory options and equipped with the highly sought-after 7-Speed Manual Transmission, this Carrera GTS delivers one of the purest driving experiences in the modern 911 lineup while offering a level of comfort equally suited to daily driving and grand touring. At its heart is Porsche's twin-turbocharged 3.0-liter flat-six, producing 473 horsepower and 420 lb-ft of torque. Paired exclusively with the 7-speed manual gearbox, the Carrera GTS rewards every shift with an engaging, analog connection that has become increasingly rare in today's performance cars. Borrowing key performance components from the 911 Turbo-including Porsche Active Suspension Management (PASM), Sport Exhaust, larger brakes, and a lowered sport suspension-the GTS occupies the ideal middle ground between the Carrera S and GT3, offering exceptional performance without sacrificing everyday usability. The timeless Carrara White Metallic finish accentuates the widebody proportions and purposeful stance unique to the Carrera GTS. Clean, understated, and unmistakably Porsche, its design reflects decades of continuous evolution while remaining instantly recognizable from every angle. An optional Electric Slide/Tilt Sunroof further enhances the driving experience, allowing occupants to enjoy open-air motoring without compromising the coupe's classic silhouette. Inside, the cabin blends sporting character with exceptional craftsmanship. The optional Mojave Beige and Black Two-Tone Leather Interior creates a sophisticated contrast against the exterior, lending the cabin a warm and inviting atmosphere while maintaining the driver's focused environment expected of a 911. Optional 14-Way Power Sport Seats with Memory provide outstanding comfort and support, while Ventilated Front Seats ensure year-round comfort in varying climates. The Leather GT Sport Steering Wheel offers a tactile connection to the road, completing an interior that is equally luxurious and performance-oriented. The Premium Package further elevates the ownership experience by adding BOSE Surround Sound, Ambient Lighting, Lane Change Assist (LCA), Power Folding Exterior Mirrors, Surround View, and the Storage Package, seamlessly integrating modern convenience and advanced technology into Porsche's driver-focused cockpit. Thoughtfully specified with an emphasis on both engagement and refinement, this 2023 Porsche 911 Carrera GTS represents the ideal expression of the modern manual-transmission 911. Its desirable factory options, elegant Carrara White Metallic over Mojave Beige and Black color combination, and analog driving experience combine to create a sports car that is as rewarding on a winding back road as it is on a cross-country journey. As manual transmissions become increasingly uncommon, examples such as this stand as enduring reminders of the connection, precision, and driving purity that continue to define the Porsche 911. The 2023 Porsche 911 Carrera continues the legacy of one of the world's most iconic sports cars––blending everyday usability with rewarding performance and an unmistakable silhouette. With a lineage that stretches back over six decades, the Carrera remains the pure-bred heart of the 911 family that's perfectly balanced between precision engineering and emotional engagement. Under the rear decklid lies a 3.0-liter twin-turbocharged flat-six boxer engine, producing 379 horsepower and 331 lb-ft of torque. Paired with Porsche's 8-speed PDK dual-clutch transmission and rear-wheel drive, the Carrera launches from 0-60 mph in around 3.9 seconds. Visually, the 2023 Carrera refines the classic 911 silhouette with modern details: sculpted body lines, flush door handles, and full-width LED taillights convey performance without excess. Inside, the Carrera's cockpit is driver-centric yet modern. Premium materials, intuitive ergonomics, and a suite of cutting-edge technology––including a 10.9-inch central touchscreen, advanced driver aids, and connectivity features––blend seamlessly with the heritage-inspired layout. The 2023 Porsche 911 Carrera is more than just the base model of a legendary lineup––it's a sports car that defines its class. The full leather sport seats provide support in high-speed cornering without sacrificing comfort for road use. Prestige Imports is proud to present this exceptional 2022 Bentley Continental, a masterpiece of British luxury and engineering prowess. With just 17,048 miles, this stunning grand tourer is finished in the exquisite **Ghost White Pearlescent by Mulliner**, a bespoke color that exemplifies elegance and exclusivity.

**Performance That Thrills**

At the heart of this Continental lies a formidable **6.0L Twin Turbo W12 engine**, delivering breathtaking power through an advanced **8-Speed Dual Clutch transmission** with active all-wheel drive. This powertrain combination ensures effortless acceleration and supreme confidence in any driving condition. The driver-selectable modes and quickshift sequential controls put complete command at your fingertips, while the adaptive suspension with front and rear auto-leveling and active anti-roll bars delivers a ride that's both supremely comfortable and dynamically engaging.

**Luxury Beyond Compare**

Step inside to discover a cabin crafted with meticulous attention to detail. The **12-way electric heated front bucket seats** with memory functions are upholstered in premium **Nappa Leather and Alcantara**, providing exceptional comfort for every journey. The full Alcantara headliner and piano black accents throughout create an atmosphere of refined sophistication. Dual-zone automatic climate control ensures perfect comfort, while the **refrigerated glovebox** keeps refreshments perfectly chilled.

**Technology and Safety**

The integrated navigation system with voice activation and 12.3" high-resolution touchscreen keeps you connected and informed. The Bentley Audio System delivers concert-hall acoustics through 10 speakers and 650 watts of power. Advanced safety features include an **aerial view camera system**, front and rear parking sensors, blind spot monitoring, collision mitigation, and comprehensive airbag protection.

**Distinctive Details**

Rolling on stunning **22" forged speed silver painted alloy wheels**, this Continental commands attention from every angle. Soft-close doors, LED headlamps with automatic high beams, and a power spoiler complete the sophisticated exterior presentation.

**Stock #AT092411 / VIN: SCBCT2ZG5NC092411**

This configuration achieves 13 city and 23 highway miles per gallon. The 2.41 limited-slip rear axle ratio enhances traction management during acceleration and cornering.

Chassis engineering incorporates four-wheel independent suspension with adaptive tuning, speed-sensing steering that adjusts responsiveness based on velocity, and comprehensive electronic stability control with traction management. Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS deliver stopping power, supported by an exterior parking camera for convenient maneuvering. The Corvette sits on a foundation of performance-focused engineering that translates to confident handling characteristics.

Experience exhilarating performance, precision engineering, and timeless styling with this 2017 Porsche 718 Cayman S Coupe, a world-class sports car designed for driving enthusiasts who demand exceptional handling and thrilling performance. With its mid-engine layout, turbocharged power, and unmistakable Porsche craftsmanship, the 718 Cayman S delivers an unforgettable driving experience on every road.

Under the hood, this 718 Cayman S is powered by a 2.5-liter turbocharged flat-four engine producing 350 horsepower and 309 lb-ft of torque, paired with a lightning-fast 7-speed Porsche Doppelkupplung (PDK) automatic transmission with manual shift mode for rapid gear changes and exhilarating acceleration. The advanced PDK transmission delivers seamless performance while allowing drivers to take full control with manual gear selection. Equipped with the available Sport Chrono Package, the Cayman S can accelerate from 0 60 MPH in as little as 4.2 seconds, offering true sports car performance.

Inside, the driver-focused cockpit features seating for two passengers and showcases Porsche s signature blend of luxury and performance. Premium appointments include leather and Alcantara upholstery, power-adjustable sport seats, dual-zone automatic climate control, a leather-wrapped multifunction steering wheel, and premium interior finishes, creating a refined yet purposeful environment.

Technology is seamlessly integrated with Porsche Communication Management (PCM) featuring a 7-inch touchscreen display, Bluetooth connectivity, navigation capability, USB connectivity, and premium audio options. Additional conveniences such as push-button start, front and rear cargo compartments, a rearview camera (when equipped), and automatic climate control make the Cayman S as practical as it is exhilarating.

Engineered for performance, the 718 Cayman S features a mid-engine chassis, Porsche Active Suspension Management (PASM), Porsche Stability Management (PSM), high-performance braking system, and precision-tuned suspension, delivering exceptional balance, confidence, and cornering capability whether on winding roads or the racetrack.

Safety features include anti-lock brakes, traction control, electronic stability control, advanced airbag systems, and Porsche's rigid safety cell construction, providing confidence without compromising performance.

On the exterior, the 718 Cayman S commands attention with its sleek aerodynamic profile, distinctive LED lighting, large side air intakes, center-mounted dual exhaust, sculpted body lines, and iconic Porsche styling, making it one of the most recognizable sports cars on the road.

With its turbocharged performance, lightning-fast 7-speed PDK transmission, world-renowned handling, luxurious interior, and unmistakable Porsche heritage, the 2017 Porsche 718 Cayman S delivers an extraordinary sports car experience that rewards every mile behind the wheel.

Contact us today to schedule a test drive and experience the precision, excitement, and performance of this Porsche 718 Cayman S.

This 2021 Dodge Challenger R/T Scat Pack delivers genuine performance and presence with its distinctive gray exterior and commanding stance on the road.

- SRT HEMI 6.4L V8 engine with 8-speed automatic transmission
- Alpine Audio Group with 506-watt amplifier and 9 amplified speakers with subwoofer
- Blind spot and cross path detection

The Scat Pack R/T represents serious automotive capability. The SRT HEMI 6.4L V8 engine paired with the 8-speed automatic transmission with AutoStick delivers the kind of responsive performance that defines this nameplate. With remote start, tip start, and steering wheel-mounted shift controls, operation is intuitive and tailored to driver preference.

Comfort and convenience are thoughtfully integrated throughout. The heated front seats and heated steering wheel address weather challenges, while the power tilt and telescope steering column allows every driver to find their ideal position. Front dual-zone automatic temperature control ensures cabin comfort for all occupants. The split-folding rear seat provides flexible interior arrangement for your needs.

Your audio and connectivity experience benefits from the Alpine Audio Group featuring a 506-watt amplifier driving nine amplified speakers with subwoofer for quality surround sound. The Uconnect 4C system with its 8.4-inch display integrates seamlessly with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, keeping you connected throughout your drive. SiriusXM satellite radio comes with a one-year trial subscription.

Safety features include blind spot and cross path detection, electronic stability control, four-wheel independent suspension with front and rear anti-roll bars, ABS braking, dual front impact airbags with side impact protection, and a ParkView rear backup camera. The emergency communication system through SiriusXM Guardian provides additional peace of mind.

With 22,904 miles, this Challenger R/T Scat Pack represents an opportunity to own a well-preserved performance vehicle. The gray finish maintains its sharp appearance, and the comprehensive feature set speaks to attentive ownership and care throughout its service life.

VIN: 1G1YA2D71E5122792 | Mileage: 4,607 miles
Asking Price: $52,995

An exceptionally low-mileage Corvette Stingray combining a 450-horsepower V8, a 7-speed manual transmission, rear-wheel drive, and unmistakable American sports-car presence.

Why This Corvette Stands Out

Some Corvettes are built for comfortable cruising. Others are configured for drivers who want to feel directly connected to the car.

This 2014 Chevrolet Corvette Stingray belongs to the second category.

With only 4,607 miles, a 7-speed manual transmission, and a 6.2-liter V8 producing 450 horsepower, it offers the increasingly rare combination of naturally engaging performance, modern comfort, and exceptionally limited use.

Its striking blue exterior, long hood, sculpted bodywork, premium wheels, and rear spoiler give it the low, aggressive stance expected from a Corvette. Inside, leather seating, heated dual-power seats, Bluetooth connectivity, Chevrolet MyLink, and a backup camera make it comfortable and practical enough to enjoy beyond an occasional weekend drive.

At a Glance

Vehicle Highlights

  • Only 4,607 miles

  • 6.2-liter V8 engine

  • 450 horsepower

  • 7-speed manual transmission

  • Rear-wheel drive

  • Two-door coupe

  • Leather interior

  • Heated dual-power seats

  • Premium 19-inch-plus wheels

  • Backup camera

  • Chevrolet MyLink

  • Bluetooth wireless connectivity

  • HID headlights

  • Rear spoiler

  • VIN: 1G1YA2D71E5122792

  • Asking price: $52,995


Our Perspective

The strongest part of this Corvette is not one individual feature. It is the complete combination.

The manual transmission gives the driver a more involved experience. The V8 provides the sound, torque, and response buyers expect from a Corvette. Rear-wheel drive preserves the traditional sports-car character, while the extremely low mileage makes this example especially difficult to duplicate.

Many performance cars of this age have accumulated significantly more mileage or have been heavily modified. This Stingray presents an opportunity for a buyer looking for a lightly used, modern Corvette with a desirable driver-focused configuration.

It has the presence to feel special when parked and the performance to make every drive memorable.

Performance and Driver-Focused Features

6.2-Liter V8

The 6.2-liter V8 produces 450 horsepower, delivering the immediate response and unmistakable soundtrack that define the Corvette experience.

Why it matters: The V8 is the heart of the Stingray. It gives the car effortless acceleration, strong passing power, and the kind of mechanical character that performance-car buyers continue to seek.

7-Speed Manual Transmission

This Corvette is equipped with a 7-speed manual transmission, giving the driver direct control over every shift.

Why it matters: Manual Corvettes are especially appealing to enthusiasts because they create a more engaging connection between the driver, engine, and rear wheels.

Rear-Wheel Drive

The traditional rear-wheel-drive layout supports the balanced, responsive personality expected from a true sports car.

Why it matters: Rear-wheel drive helps preserve the Corvette s driver-focused character and delivers a more involving experience than a typical all-wheel-drive performance vehicle.

Traction Control and StabiliTrak

Electronic traction control and StabiliTrak help manage available power and support stability during changing driving conditions.

Why it matters: These systems provide added confidence without taking away from the car s performance-oriented nature.

Four-Wheel ABS

Four-wheel anti-lock brakes help maintain steering control during harder braking situations.

Why it matters: Strong, predictable braking is essential in a vehicle with this level of performance.

Exterior Highlights

Premium 19-Inch-Plus Wheels

The premium wheels complement the Stingray s wide stance and performance-focused proportions.

Why it matters: The wheel design and sizing play an important role in how a Corvette presents, giving the vehicle a more complete and aggressive appearance.

Rear Spoiler

The rear spoiler adds a sportier finishing detail to the Corvette s sculpted rear profile.

Why it matters: It strengthens the car s visual presence and reinforces the performance character of the Stingray design.

HID Headlights and Daytime Running Lights

HID headlights provide a crisp, modern appearance and enhanced nighttime visibility.

Why it matters: They improve both function and road presence, especially when combined with the Corvette s distinctive front-end design.

Fog Lights

Integrated fog lights provide additional visibility while completing the vehicle s low, performance-oriented front fascia.

Interior and Comfort

Leather Seating

The leather-trimmed cabin gives the Corvette a more premium environment while maintaining its driver-focused layout.

Why it matters: The Stingray is not only about speed. Its interior is designed to make longer drives, weekend trips, and everyday use more enjoyable.

Heated Dual-Power Seats

Both front seats feature power adjustment, with heated seating for additional comfort.

Why it matters: These features make it easier for both driver and passenger to find a comfortable seating position while adding year-round usability.

Tilt and Telescoping Steering Wheel

The steering wheel can be adjusted for both height and reach.

Why it matters: Proper driving position is especially important in a low sports car, and this feature allows the cockpit to be tailored more precisely to the driver.

Keyless Entry and Keyless Start

Keyless entry and push-button starting provide convenient access without removing the key from your pocket.

Why it matters: It adds modern everyday convenience to the Corvette ownership experience.

Technology and Convenience

This Stingray includes:

  • Chevrolet MyLink

  • Bluetooth wireless connectivity

  • SiriusXM satellite radio

  • AM/FM stereo

  • CD and MP3 capability

  • Backup camera

  • Cruise control

  • Power windows

  • Power door locks

  • Air conditioning

  • Alarm system

  • Power steering

The technology is straightforward and driver-focused, providing the connectivity and convenience most buyers expect without distracting from the purpose of the car.

Behind the Wheel

The Corvette Stingray delivers an experience that begins before the vehicle moves.

The low seating position, long hood, driver-oriented cockpit, and V8 startup immediately communicate that this is not an ordinary coupe. The manual transmission makes each drive more intentional, while the 450-horsepower engine provides more than enough performance for open-road driving.

At the same time, features such as heated power seats, Bluetooth, cruise control, and a backup camera make the Stingray easier to enjoy regularly.

This is a Corvette for the buyer who wants more than impressive specifications. It is for someone who still values the process of driving.

Why Enthusiasts Value This Configuration

Enthusiasts continue to value manual-transmission Corvettes because they represent a more traditional and interactive type of performance car.

This example combines several highly desirable characteristics:

  • Exceptionally low mileage

  • V8 power

  • Manual transmission

  • Rear-wheel drive

  • Classic two-seat coupe proportions

  • Modern comfort and safety technology

  • Distinctive Corvette styling

With only 4,607 miles, this vehicle offers the opportunity to own a lightly driven Stingray without stepping into the price range of a new performance car.

Purchase With Confidence

Independent pre-purchase inspections are welcome, and our team can discuss available financing, trade-in, and transportation options based on the buyer s location and needs.

Frequently Asked Questions

Can I purchase this Corvette remotely?

Yes. Contact SR Auto Group to request detailed photographs, a personalized video presentation, document review, and transportation assistance.

Can I arrange an independent inspection?

Yes. Third-party pre-purchase inspections can be coordinated with reasonable notice.

Is financing available?

Financing options may be available for qualified buyers. Contact our team for current programs and requirements.

Do you accept trade-ins?

Trade-in evaluations are available. Provide your vehicle s VIN, mileage, photographs, options, and current condition for review.

Can I request a personalized walkaround?

Yes. We can prepare a live or recorded walkaround focused on the exterior, interior, startup, controls, condition, and any specific areas you would like to inspect.

Experience the thrill of precision driving with the 2014 Chevrolet Corvette Stingray Z51 in striking Torch Red, designed for enthusiasts who demand performance and style.


This Corvette Stingray Z51 boasts a formidable 6.2L V8 engine paired with a 7-speed manual transmission featuring active rev matching, delivering seamless shifts and an exhilarating connection to the road. The rear-wheel-drive layout combined with a locking limited-slip differential ensures exceptional handling and cornering confidence. Performance tires front and rear grip the pavement, while the Z51 performance package enhances braking and suspension for razor-sharp control.


Inside, the cockpit is tailored for the driver with heated and cooled leather bucket seats offering adjustable lumbar support for both driver and passenger, ensuring comfort during spirited drives. The heads-up display keeps vital information in your line of sight, while the premium sound system and smart device integration provide entertainment and connectivity without distraction. Advanced safety features like stability and traction control, multiple airbags, and a backup camera give peace of mind without compromising the driving experience.


With keyless start, navigation, and a suite of driver-focused tech, this Stingray is as intelligent as it is powerful. For those who crave a pure, engaging sports car experience, this Corvette Stingray Z51 is ready to ignite your passion for the open road.

Adaptive full LED lighting technology adapts to road conditions, while the power moonroof floods the cabin with natural light.

Safety and connectivity are built in throughout. Dual front and side airbags, knee airbags, and an emergency communication system provide peace of mind. ConnectedDrive Services and BMW TeleServices keep you connected, while the rear parking camera assists with maneuvering.

At just 18,441 miles, this 2024 M240i xDrive remains virtually new, offering warranty coverage and years of dependable performance. The combination of sport capability, premium features, and practical efficiency makes this an excellent choice for the discerning driver. We invite you to schedule a test drive and experience the precision and refinement that define the BMW 2 Series.

- 5.0L V8 Ti-VCT engine with 10-Speed Automatic transmission
- Active Valve Performance Exhaust with quad chrome tailpipes
- 19" x 8.5" Premier Polished Aluminum wheels
- SelectShift with paddle shifters for driver control
- SYNC 4.0 QNX infotainment system
- Leather steering wheel and leather-wrapped shift knob
- Premium floor liners front and rear
- Rear parking sensors and exterior parking camera
- Remote Start System
- Automatic temperature control with rear window defroster
- Electronic Stability Control and traction control
- Four-wheel independent suspension with speed-sensing steering
- Auto high-beam headlights with rain-sensing wipers
- Front bucket seats with front center armrest

With just 5,425 miles, this Silver Mustang GT Premium offers the confidence of a nearly-new vehicle with all the capability you expect from this iconic nameplate. The responsive 5.0L V8 engine provides the power that defines the GT experience, while the 10-Speed Automatic transmission seamlessly manages both everyday driving and spirited performance.

Inside, premium features surround you with quality and control. The leather steering wheel and shift knob feel substantial in your hands, while the sport-tuned suspension and paddle shifters put driving dynamics at your fingertips. SYNC 4.0 QNX keeps you connected and entertained, with intuitive controls positioned for easy access during your drive.

The Active Valve Performance Exhaust elevates the acoustic character while the polished aluminum wheels add visual distinction that matches the car's aggressive stance. Premium floor liners protect your investment, and the rear parking sensors with exterior camera provide practical assistance when maneuvering.

This Mustang GT Premium is engineered for those who appreciate authentic performance combined with contemporary convenience. Whether navigating daily commutes or pursuing weekend drives, this vehicle delivers the balance of reliability and excitement that makes the Mustang nameplate legendary.

We invite you to visit our showroom to experience this outstanding example firsthand. Our team looks forward to helping you explore ownership of this impressive machine.

Safety and convenience features include blind spot and cross path detection, high-intensity discharge headlamps, power multi-function foldaway mirrors, and a rearview camera. The heated front seats and automatic climate control add comfort for any season, while remote keyless entry and the remote start system enhance daily usability.

With 66,566 miles on the odometer, this Challenger remains well-maintained and ready for its next chapter of ownership. The combination of iconic design, proven performance hardware, and modern convenience technology makes this a genuinely well-rounded muscle car that doesn't require compromise.

This 2020 Ford Mustang GT Premium stands as a compelling choice for drivers seeking authentic performance and distinctive style in the sports car market.

- GT Performance Package
- 5.0L V8 Ti-VCT Engine with 6-Speed Manual Transmission
- 19" x 9" Front and 19" x 9.5" Rear Ebony Black Wheels
- Larger Brake Rotors and Heavy-Duty Front Springs
- Larger Radiator for enhanced cooling
- Heated and Ventilated Front Leather Bucket Seats
- Climate-Controlled Front Seats
- Front Dual Zone Automatic Temperature Control
- SYNC 3 Communications & Entertainment System with SiriusXM Radio
- Rear View Camera
- Electronic Stability Control and Traction Control
- Heated Door Mirrors with Power Adjustment
- Telescoping and Tilt Steering Wheel
- Front Fog Lights with Fully Automatic Headlights
- Remote Keyless Entry with Illuminated Entry

The striking orange exterior immediately distinguishes this Mustang, making a statement before you even turn the key. The muscular proportions and bold design lines communicate the performance heritage that defines this nameplate, while the premium trim designation ensures refined appointments that enhance daily driving.

Power comes from the legendary 5.0L V8 Ti-VCT engine paired with a 6-Speed Manual transmission, delivering authentic driver engagement. The GT Performance Package elevates the experience with larger brake rotors designed for stopping capability, heavy-duty front springs for improved handling response, and a larger radiator to maintain optimal operating temperatures during spirited driving.

The interior reflects careful attention to comfort and functionality. Heated and ventilated leather front bucket seats with climate control technology ensure comfort across varying conditions. SYNC 3 provides intuitive access to entertainment and vehicle information, while remote keyless entry and illuminated entry ease your arrival. The driver benefits from power seat adjustment, telescoping and tilt steering wheel control, and trip computer functions that provide valuable operational data.

Safety receives thoughtful treatment through dual front and front side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags positioned throughout the cabin. Four-wheel independent suspension combined with electronic stability control, traction control, and speed-sensing steering technology work in concert to support confident vehicle management. The rear view camera adds visibility when maneuvering in tight spaces.

This 2020 Mustang GT Premium represents an opportunity to own a recognized American performance icon with documented maintenance and forward-thinking features. The combination of authentic V8 engagement, premium comfort appointments, and purposeful design makes this vehicle worthy of your consideration. We invite you to schedule a viewing and experience this Mustang firsthand.
